summary: Clean, well-scoped feature that wires a per-Text antialiased state through the GraphicsContext into the agg and cairo backends; mirrors existing artist get/set_antialiased conventions and resolves the issue. The math-text limitation is documented and only minor API/consistency nits remain, so it is mergeable.

issues.description: Per-Text antialiased setting has no effect on math expressions (mathtext follows a separate draw path). This is a real functional gap but it is explicitly documented in the set_antialiased docstring, so it is an acceptable known limitation rather than a blocker.

Cairo's new GraphicsContext.get_antialiased() returns a cairo ANTIALIAS_* enum, whereas the base GraphicsContextBase.get_antialiased() returns a bool. It is self-consistent within the cairo backend (fed straight into set_antialias/set_font_options), but it diverges from the base-class return contract; harmless here since no cross-backend code depends on it.

set_antialiased docstring wording is slightly confusing ('Antialiasing will be determined by rc:text.antialiased and the parameter will have no effect if the text contains math') — could more clearly state the math-only caveat. Cosmetic.
